title: Robust GNSS-denied localization for UAV using particle filter and visual odometry
authors: Jurevičius R.; Marcinkevičius V.; Šeibokas J.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
